title: Empirical Confidence in Level-0 Bounded Execution
current_summary: The core Run/Hop evaluator-optimizer kernel is materially more stable than in September. Between 2026-09-30 and 2026-10-12 WFC-on-WFC Runs implemented and independently accepted correction-convergence escape Slices 1-4, Projected Result Contracts P1 and P2, the evidence-failure disposition admission rule, and durable-artifact completion-handoff hardening; several bounded WorkItems closed in exactly two Hops with trusted evidence PASS and zero Findings (RUN-889559c6, RUN-26e233c9, RUN-65952de3, RUN-b419abdd). Independent review kept finding real defects, and a later out-of-band assurance review found further material defects in an already-accepted slice. No instance of silent authority widening was observed: the stops examined were either correct fail-closed refusals -- typed authority escalation rather than self-widening, no trusted commit from an invalid result, an open blocking Finding blocking completion, a missing durable artifact causing preemption, an invalid profile topology refused before provider invocation -- or operator interruptions whose work was preserved as non-authoritative salvage.
next_action: Keep treating convergence as proven only for routes actually exercised. All Run evidence added to this repository in the interval is WFC self-development, so consumer-repository coverage remains what SIG-ACT-WFC-RELKEY-S3B-CONVERGENCE established; broaden it with real Core/Latin consumer Runs before generalizing, and do not generalize clean two-Hop self-development Runs to arbitrary-task autonomy.
notes: Hop outcome, Run outcome, and WorkItem completion are three different altitudes (DEC-WFC-015). A Run that stopped correctly is positive evidence for the mechanism and never evidence that its WorkItem completed. Do not generalize to general correctness, general safety, production readiness, or arbitrary-task autonomy.

title: Execution Trust and Containment Boundary
current_summary: Still no Coordinator-owned or Coordinator-verified OS/environment containment boundary, and still no resource/effect classification, derived security floor, derived assurance floor, profile admission against derived floors, information-flow containment, or model-eligibility derivation in source at HEAD; today's control remains human-authored policy and profile. Recent non-authorizing architecture reasoning sharpened what such a mechanism would have to respect: capability/execution-surface escalation can be controlled after the mutation (mandatory defensive review), whereas protected information access must be resolved before disclosure because a later review cannot undo information flow; a classification lattice or taint-tracking engine stays a non-goal, with only an ingress/egress compatibility predicate surviving.
next_action: Revisit FTR-WFC-EXECUTION-TRUST-BOUNDARIES only on a concrete consumer or Level-1 need. If information-flow or model-eligibility policy is ever built, the constrained part of the execution binding must move inside the pinned governing-input digest set first: the binding is currently an un-pinned file written from a CLI flag and is kept outside `governing` precisely on the premise that it grants no authority, a premise that fails the moment a binding choice can decide whether protected context may be disclosed.
notes: Provider sandbox modes (e.g. Codex --sandbox workspace-write) remain provider-owned behavior, not Coordinator-trusted (DEC-WFC-009). The reasoning above comes from non-authorizing concepts and is not evidence that any data-zone, capability-derivation, assurance-floor, or model-capability-floor mechanism exists.

title: Run Continuation and Recovery Operator Wiring Gap
current_summary: The two mechanisms this concern tracks have diverged. Semantic successor continuation was designed and implemented (2026-10-01/02): an immutable SemanticStop recorded before the controlling mechanical stop_reason is selected, backward-only SuccessorProvenance, and two explicit operator commands, `export-salvage` and `prepare-successor`, present in operator.py at HEAD. That implementation is not independently accepted: the lineage's last rereview (dfc0416) returned CHANGES REQUIRED with carried requirement R1A open -- post-publication canonicalization and deferred stdout flush can report failure while a consumer-valid bundle is already published at the requested destination -- and no correction attempt followed. Maintainer salvage was separately canonicalized as a procedure (DEC-WFC-013) and is exercised routinely. Same-Run Charged-Hop suspend/reconcile/resume remains modeled and unit-tested in the reducer with no production operator entry point.
next_action: Close carried requirement R1A on `export-salvage`/`prepare-successor` through a separately authorized correction before describing that mechanism as accepted anywhere; wire same-Run reconcile/resume only on concrete evidence of a real interruption need.
notes: FTR-WFC-ATOMIC-HOP-RECOVERY explicitly excludes a generic outer loop and covers only same-Run technical recovery; DEC-WFC-014 governs the separate fresh-successor mechanism. Note a wording discrepancy to read carefully: `docs/run-recovery-and-salvage.adoc` calls that mechanism 'already productized' without mentioning R1A. The primary evidence for the open status recorded here is `docs/backlog/FTR-WFC-SCOPE-ESCALATION-CONTINUATION_implementation_review_004.adoc`.

title: Higher-Order Autonomous Caller Mediation Boundary
current_summary: Unchanged in substance and reaffirmed by the 2026-10-12 reviewed boundary work: the caller-mediation boundary becomes mandatory once an above-Level-0 actor is autonomous rather than supervised, and today's residual ambient capability of a supervised caller is an accepted, explicitly named deployment risk. The sharpened formulation is that the requirement is not 'route the call through Level 0' but 'ensure the above-Level-0 caller has nothing to escalate with': an interactive authoring assistant is admissible only because it holds no repository write authority and no protected-context access, and that property is currently procedural rather than mechanical.
next_action: Design the caller-mediation boundary, and make governing-input provenance mechanically rather than procedurally distinguishable from agent-produced output, before any autonomous (non-supervised) Level-1 actor materializes governing inputs or is granted access to WFC.
notes: A 'cooperative caller' is defined precisely by the product-boundary concept and explicitly excludes a well-behaved autonomous orchestrator. These two preconditions -- caller mediation and mechanical authorship provenance -- are the recorded gates on any move away from per-Run maintainer authorization.

title: Project Memory Promotion Protocol Proportionality
current_summary: The simplification named by DEC-WFC-010 was implemented (871ab14) and the independent review this concern was waiting for has in fact happened: 9b9e99e (2026-09-28) returned CHANGES REQUIRED with 0 BLOCKING, 0 IMPORTANT, 1 MINOR, 1 INFO. The Git-backed architecture is correctly implemented for the documented serial maintainer flow -- retired state machine gone, import fail-closed before canonical mutation, dirty-canonical guard effective, round-trip invariant and real pinned-tool integration all verified. Acceptance was withheld for one reason only: the blanket claim that no `make` invocation mode including `-j` can act on stale output is false, demonstrated by a `make -j2 memory-export memory-import` probe in which both targets exited zero while a workbook edit was lost. That claim is still present at HEAD in `Makefile` lines 46-47 and in `project_memory/README.adoc`.
next_action: Narrow the parallel-safety statement in `Makefile` and `project_memory/README.adoc` to say that memory targets sharing the workbook or canonical JSON must be invoked serially, then close this concern. Do not add locking, leases, journals, promotion identity, or transaction machinery.
notes: See DEC-WFC-010. The concurrent-promotion finding from 773ea97 is moot rather than fixed: no promotion operation remains to race. The strong-staging implementation (aa219a6, d201af5) and its reviews (56f4a04, 773ea97) remain in Git history as reusable evidence should a future use case need multi-user delayed-approval promotion. The review also raised one INFO item: the canonical-directory symlink refusal is deliberately stricter than its diagnostic wording suggests.

current_summary: P1 (one closed ResultContractKind, one pure select_result_contract selector over declared profile/phase/Run facts, the selected kind threaded through AgentExecutionRequest, and the kind/version pair persisted as a sibling pair on Hop/HopSummary with replay failing closed on an incomplete or unsupported pair) and P2 (distinct frozen WorkResult and ReviewVerdict types with disjoint strict provider schemas; the generic RoutingResult path retained for convergence roles) are implemented, independently accepted, and contained in the Runtime at 0ab2063. next_action: Dispose the P3 stop at whichever authority level owns the incorrect withheld-adapter.py boundary assumption, then, only if that disposition so decides, author a fresh successor P3 Commission stating its authority delta explicitly -- no current record authorizes changing adapter.py's version gate; keep P3.5, P4 and P5 unimplemented until each is separately commissioned.

The near-term direction recorded in the 2026-10-11 friction evidence is P3 -> P3.5 -> P4 -> P5 -> provider-neutrality/Claude adapter, with simplification becoming a primary programme afterwards; that is a dated maintainer planning observation, not a committed roadmap and not implementation authority. title: Commission / Profile Coherence and Authority Composition
current_summary: A Commission can be locally well-formed and still be globally unable to complete, and this is the most frequently reproduced correctness failure class around an otherwise healthy loop. The finding-authority composition defect has been reproduced in independent lineages (S3-002 and the P1 implementation Run RUN-157080a2), each stopping awaiting_human with open blocking Findings no later phase could dispose; the latent empty-authority convention spanned every predecessor self-development profile of that lineage (S1-001 through S2-003). Three non-accepting P2 Runs came from evidence placement and route topology, and the P3 Commission needed two provider-free PREPARE refusals (persona over 512 UTF-8 bytes; required evidence on a non-gate worker phase, an invariant accepted days earlier). BUG-WFC-SELF-DEVELOPMENT-GATE-FINDING-AUTHORITY remains open; its engine-level generalization is reserved as the unimplemented P3.5 slice, so today's only remedies are per-Commission authority grants and late PREPARE-time refusal.
next_action: Author least-privilege but correctly ordered finding_authority in every new Commission -- authority located only at or before the phase that can open a blocking Finding does not satisfy reachability, because permitted operations are computed from the currently executing Hop's phase alone. Treat an authoring-time validator running the existing provider-free admission checks before PREPARE reserves an attempt identifier as the cheapest next step. P3.5 itself remains unauthorized.
notes: Evidence placement is already mechanically enforced -- see DEC-WFC-012. When P3.5 eventually ships it is expected deliberately to revoke new-launch admissibility for eight named self-development profile lineages while keeping them parseable, truthfully replayable, and usable as regression fixtures; that revocation is the intended effect, not a regression.

title: Operational Friction and AI-Maintainability of the Repository
current_summary: The 2026-10-11 friction record establishes from Run-ledger and session evidence that the dominant emerging complexity is not the Run/Hop evaluator-optimizer loop but the distributed specification and lifecycle machinery around it: Commission authoring, cross-artifact conformance, continuation and successor semantics, evidence and durable-artifact obligations, historical compatibility, operator coordination, and the amount of long-lived maintainer and assistant context routine operation currently consumes. Counter-evidence is explicit: several bounded WorkItems completed cleanly in two Hops once the Commission encoded the intended semantics, and independent review has repeatedly caught real defects. One measured, materially underused seam exists: two prompt components of 204 and 231 bytes against a 65,536-byte per-component and 196,608-byte total budget, with every `modifiers`/`repository_policy` selector empty across 124 phases of 36 profiles, while reusable role material overflowed the 512-byte persona field and a single-use task file reached 23,173 bytes.
next_action: Capture the record's baseline metrics before any simplification programme, and take the two no-new-mechanism steps first: populate the existing digest-pinned prompt-component mechanism, and add an authoring-time validator over the existing provider-free admission checks. Judge anything further by whether Commission lines authored per WorkItem, duplicated scope declarations, provider-free preflight refusals, and consumed attempt identifiers actually fall. Never reduce friction by weakening fail-closed behavior.
notes: Standing acceptance test: can a fresh agent, given the repository plus a bounded handoff, determine the next correct action without reconstructing months of chat history? Project Memory is one of the artifacts that must make that true. The component measurement is from the Commissioning concept lineage (recorded 54a125c, amended 009aed3), whose section 2.5 measured the profile corpus at baseline 6270069; it is not from the friction record itself. A concrete instance of the same discoverability problem: `docs/wfc_operator_manual.adoc` and everything under `docs/warm_storage/` are current operator practice and active design material but are not classified in the `docs/README.adoc` authority index.

title: Level-1 Responsibility and the Level-1 / Level-0 Boundary
current_summary: Level 0 is increasingly treated as the trusted execution kernel: admission, bounded execution, provider invocation, trusted effects, evidence mechanics, fail-closed reduction, typed stops/escalations, and exact Run/Hop provenance. Level 1 is still substantially under-specified and is occupied by the maintainer plus an interactive assistant. Candidate Level-1 duties recorded across the 2026-10-10/11/12 concepts are deliberately broader than escalation classification plus Commission authoring: goal custody, work selection, decomposition, dependency and lineage reasoning, semantic task classification, architecture disposition, successor planning, lifecycle interpretation, closure and milestone judgment, promotion recommendation, semantic curation, and eventual higher-order orchestration. After independent review and amendment the preferred hypothesis is one authority-free deterministic projection component on the requesting side plus completion of a derivation duty already assigned to Level 0; no new trust-bearing service between the levels is accepted as needed.
next_action: Let the hypothesis mature through further observed cases rather than a platform build. Each step would need its own Commission; the cheapest recorded steps add no new artifact at all. Treat the escalation ladder (Commission / Slice concept / Epic / programme) as Level-1 prose vocabulary, not schema, and keep architecture disposition out of Level 0 until repeated evidence shows existing stops, profiles and successor Commissions cannot carry it.
notes: The candidate Level-1 duty list and the preferred boundary split above are non-authorizing hypothesis, not accepted architecture; only the implemented Level-0 duties and the fact that a human occupies the tier above are current reality. CommissionIntent would be a canonical AUTHORING source for a render transaction; the committed and admitted governing inputs remain the canonical EXECUTION authority, and current Level 0 knows no CommissionIntent. Trusted capability derivation, information-flow containment, assurance floors, and model-eligibility or model-capability-floor derivation are all unbuilt (see CONC-WFC-EXECUTION-TRUST-BOUNDARY). A standing TaskAssessment envelope is possible, not available: assessment may advise and may never grant scope, capability, information access, architecture authority, or provider eligibility, and its task-input, readable-context, eligibility and provenance envelope is undesigned. Routing model-assisted assessment through a common Level-0 execution seam may later be attractive for non-governance reasons (DRY, telemetry, provenance, reproducibility, budgets, adapter consistency); that is not an invariant and not implemented.
